title: Reminders UI mockups before any build
context: Brief reminders-webui requires the operator to see HTML mockups before W1-W3.
decision: Six static HTML screens plus open questions under .shipwright/planning/campaigns/reminders-webui-mockups/; no production code.
consequences: Campaign stops at needs_operator until the operator says go; W1-W3 are re-scoped from the approved mockups.
rationale: Cheap to change a page, expensive to change a built bridge and mail timer.
rejected: Building the server bridge first; clickable React prototype.
